items.title: scaffold + SKILL.md + activation/scope-guard
items.scope: Loadable skill skeleton; Scope Guard routes code->parallel-development / spec-authoring->blueprint-crafting; Q4 explicit-invocation noted (3-way trigger_check deferred).
items.risk: activation collision with bc/pd on review-type requests; mitigated by Q4 explicit-invocation + Scope Guard.

items.title: schemas: doc-findings + convergence-record
items.scope: doc-findings.schema.json (generalize bc review-findings; v1 kind enum = 6 Q2 kinds; severity keeps bc {blocker,warning,coverage} - coverage is honest-disclosure, distinct from coverage-gap KIND) + convergence-record.schema.json (fields name-aligned to loop_state run-record; no code dep).
items.risk: doc-findings kind enum drifts from bc review-findings; mitigated by Q2 lock + documented mapping (FX-04).

items.title: same-source leg: skill-local doc-reviewer agent
items.scope: Fresh-context, read-only, outcome-axis-barred doc-reviewer agent returning doc-findings shape; NOT plan-reviewer (plan-model-shaped).
items.risk: wrongly reusing plan-reviewer as the leg; mitigated by Q5/FX-05 (skill-local reviewer).

items.title: heterogeneous substrate: copy-pattern hetero_review.py, doc-adapted
items.scope: Copy-pattern pd hetero_review.py (FLAG-SURFACE MANIFEST, token-injection, fence-aware parse, substrate-error DEGRADE, multi-provider merge) with a DOC prompt + doc-findings schema; no --diff/--blueprint hard-require. Preserve function-signature contract + divergence log.
items.source_location: proposal.md §3, §5, §8; hetero_review.py is the pattern source
items.risk: copy silently drifts from hetero_review.py, breaking Phase-B B1/B3; mitigated by §5 interface-compat constraint (signature contract + divergence log, F3).

items.title: convergence loop driver
items.scope: Orchestrate 同源<->异源 multi-round debate: caps by artifact size (short=2/long=5-7), substantive-convergence BOTH prongs (no-new-Blocker AND core-claims-coverage; not zero-finding), per-round reconciliation table, cap->human, adversarial-stalemate, don't-blind-trust-either; OWNS the proposal §3 pluggable-seam (findings-schema as parameter + 同源-leg as callback); emit convergence-record.
items.risk: chasing zero-finding (infinite loop on docs); mitigated by substantive-convergence doctrine + caps (this proposal's own loop validated it).

items.title: self-gates (Q6) + standard set
items.scope: Three skill-specific gates (dogfood own loop on own SKILL.md - SKIPS gracefully w/o API tokens, recorded log substitutes; findings shape-contract mirror adapter_shape_check; offline convergence-policy mirror hetero_review_wiring + core-claims-coverage fixture) PLUS standard (disconnect_check/plugin_layout/lint_self).
items.risk: leg emit path produces malformed findings; mitigated by findings shape-contract gate.

items.title: dogfood + 质量稳定 gate (Q7)
items.scope: Run the skill on N>=3 real docs (>=1 long-doc cap=5-7 + own SKILL.md as one of the N); record a measured convergence profile.
items.risk: dogfood N too small to validate long-doc convergence; mitigated by Q7 (>=1 long-doc required).
